captions: The search starts from the start's 4-seed mean, 34%: the bar each network has to beat.
Round 1, r1c1: Footprint-aware placement head. Seeds 72% and 32%, mean 52%. New best.
Round 1, r1c2: Orthogonal init, small policy heads. Seeds 16% and 16%, mean 16%.
Round 1, r1c3: Deeper residual narrow net, footprint head. Seeds 64% and 29%, mean 46%.
Round 2, r2c1: Footprint head with raw-cell skip. Seeds 34% and 64%, mean 49%.
Round 2, r2c2: Footprint head with global context. Seeds 27% and 71%, mean 49%.
Round 2, r2c3: 3D voxel net, per-layer footprint head. Seeds 90% and 29%, mean 60%. New best.
Round 3, r3c1: Voxel net, whole-column context. Seeds 88% and 37%, mean 62%. New best.
Round 3, r3c2: Voxel net, separate small critic. Seeds 91% and 37%, mean 64%. New best.
Round 3, r3c3: Slim voxel net, full step budget. Seeds 83% and 28%, mean 55%.
Round 4, r4c1: Voxel: column context + separate critic. Seeds 88% and 90%, mean 89%. New best.
Round 4, r4c2: Combo + learned landing gate over z. Seeds 45% and 78%, mean 62%.
Round 4, r4c3: Combo + dilated xy conv, full-grid view. Seeds 40% and 81%, mean 61%.
Each dot is a 2-seed score on the same dev designs the search chose on.
A running best rises even under pure noise. An illustration, not evidence.
